title: Accounts Memorandum — What the Office Carries for Migrating the Point Map a Monitoring Subscription Reads

# Accounts Memorandum — What the Office Carries for Migrating the Point Map a Monitoring Subscription Reads

**What the office carries.** Where an energy monitoring subscription the owner holds stands active, reads its data from the controls system and covers more meters than its own tier includes, a quarter of an hour — 0.25 of an hour — of the tier's on-site controls technician rate for each meter that subscription covers is carried by the office against the upgrade labor of the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans. Where an energy monitoring subscription the owner holds stands active, reads its data from the controls system and covers no more meters than its own tier includes, an eighth of an hour, that is 0.125 of an hour, of that rate for each such meter is carried by the office. In every other case nothing is carried by the office. The figure is taken to two decimal places.

The subscription, its standing, the source its data is drawn from, the meters it covers and the meters its own tier includes are read from the office's records of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions held by that owner.

| Energy monitoring subscription standing active | The source its data is drawn from | Meters covered against the meters its own tier includes | Carried by the office |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | the controls system | more than included | 0.25 of an hour of the tier's on-site controls technician rate for each meter covered |
| yes | the controls system | no more than included | 0.125 of an hour of that rate for each meter covered |
| yes | any other source | any | nothing |
| no | not read | not read | nothing |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A subscription under the Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions standing active, drawing its data from the controls system, covering 16 meters where its own tier includes 10, at a plan tier whose on-site controls technician rate is 150 USD an hour: the office carries 16 multiplied by 0.25 of an hour, that is 4 hours, at 150 USD, so 600.00 USD. Covering 8 meters where its own tier includes 10, the office carries 8 multiplied by 0.125 of an hour, that is 1 hour, so 150.00 USD.
